question: Does the unchanged native learned-exit decoder replicate its gain on an independent 48-item pair from both original sources?
decision: Qualification requires a passed primary pair and positive blinded content margin. Use 24 unused reserved GSM8K items and 24 unused operation-balanced SVAMP items. Identical zero-example, thinking-on prompt IDs, ordered items, greedy generation and 1024-token cap. Count full replay latency. Replication requires >=2 net strict correct and a positive net on each source, total time <= Base, retained raw V3 NLL <= Base+0.03; the 256-token streams must be identical. Blindly score completed prose before promotion. Report exact pooled paired p across both panels; claims of statistically reliable superiority require pooled p<0.05. Close larger expansion on failure. No optimizer or decoding-policy changes.
exclusion_note: All 1319 official GSM8K test questions occur in the historical Phase 2 inventory. This replication uses prospectively frozen, disjoint publisher-train questions. No model measurements were run on the inventoried test split for this study.
